Greetings, Agents!

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

A new Native Tier-3 Hero has been added!

 

A patch is scheduled on 1/19 so that our Agents can actually play as 

Knull, the King in Black.

 

If you are ready to harness his mighty powers,
prepare to challenge the World Boss: Legend Difficulty!

 

Various heroes with new Potential Awakening and Tier-3
will be of great help in defeating Knull!  

 

[1/20 2:31 a.m. (UTC+0) / 1/19 6:31 p.m. (PST) Added]

The patch has been completed. Please reconnect to the game and download the patch file.


■ 1/19 Patch
Patch Schedule: Scheduled to be completed by 1/20 4:00 a.m. (UTC+0) / 1/19 8:00 p.m. (PST)
* The patch will be applied in waves, so the patch application time may vary.
* The game can be played during the patch. 
   We recommend our Agents reconnect to the game to apply the patch once it is available.


▣ New Native Tier-3 Hero, Knull Added

 

 

 

▣ Knull Tier-3 Ultimate Skill

 


[Knull Tier-3 Animation]

 


▣ Native Tier-3 Growth Materials Added

 

New materials for the growth of Native Tier-3 heroes have been added.
Cosmic Cube Fragments can be combined and dismantled into 6 different ranks.

 


As Native Tier-3 heroes possess overwhelming powers,
the cost and type of growth materials may increase or differ compared to other heroes.

 

Please check the required materials in the game.

 

 

▣ Sif Potential Awakening & Transcend Potential Added

 

  
[Sif Animation]

 

 

▣ Other Information
 
1. [Power Cosmic] has been added in the ability of the Thor <Herald of Thunder> uniform.
    The World Boss Striker effect has been changed to [Power Cosmic].
2. The skill motions of the Valkyrie <Fearless Defenders> uniform has been improved.
3. One of the abilities of Sentry <Modern>, [Strong], has been changed to [Leadership].
    The World Boss Striker effect has been changed to [Leadership].

 

 

▣ Game Error Fixes
 
1. The issue of the growth materials required for enhancing the Potential of Molecule Man being applied differently than planned has been fixed.
2. The omitted text of "Applies to: Self" in White Fox’s <Lifestyle Series 2> Passive Skill Blood Scent has been added. 
3. The ‘Increases Chain Hit damage’ effect in the Thor <Herald of Thunder> uniform has been changed so that the effect can be stacked with a Custom Gear effect.
4. The issue where Aragorn remains displayed after relocating Valkyrie while equipping the <Fearless Defenders> uniform at the My Team screen has been fixed.
 
Moreover, there are Events to celebrate the release of Knull,
so we look forward to seeing active participation from our Agents.

 

Thank you.
